verdict.rationale: Helicone provides API-key based access to its gateway and lets you bring your own provider keys, and it supports per-user rate limits, but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege credential issuance (e.g., read-only, model-restricted, or per-agent permissioned keys) for agents. Missing for 10: documented scoped/role-based API key creation, per-agent permission controls, or a credentials/IAM system limiting what an agent's key can do.
